rulings.calls: a direct call of a script function records its argument count; once every function is lowered a count the callee does not take refuses the program with Arity at the call, so stock runs it (C17e closure-arity precedent)
rulings.stock_defect: stock rewrites a call to an already assembled script function into CallOffset, which skips check_args: too many arguments run silently, too few leak the internal Empty value as a result, and a self call recurses until fuel runs out; COPY: fresh refuses, stock behavior unchanged; a separate stock record fixes it
rulings.limits: 16 MiB of code (refused at the function whose code crosses the budget), 65,536 functions and 4,096 host descriptors are one CodeLimit refusal, located
rulings.entry: an entry invoked with the wrong argument count is the stock ArgumentCount error, without a site
